title: Desk view v0
description: A view: a surface that shows items, written as data instead of code, so it is validated at install and shared without review (ADR 0032). The person's views live as YAML files in ~/.desk/views, one per view and named by its id (desk.today.yaml); on the wire a view is JSON of the same shape.

description.description: One sentence about what the view shows.

requires.description: The sources the view needs, by name. Bindings name them as $name; the person picks an instance for each when the view opens.

params.description: Values the person sets when the view opens, by name. Templates read them by name: {params.days}.

ViewId.description: Lowercase and dotted like a plugin id: desk.today, example.sprint-board.

RequireName.description: A requires entry's name: calendar, tasks, work-mail.

ViewRequirement.description: One source a view needs: items of these kinds, optionally from one connector.

connector.description: Only this connector's instances will do; absent, any connector with the kinds.

title.description: What the person is asked for: A calendar.

ParamName.description: A param's name: days, project, showDone.

ViewParam.description: One param: a string, an integer, a boolean or one of a list of choices. Without a default the person is asked when the view opens.

IntegerParam.description: A whole-number param, optionally within bounds.

EnumParam.description: A param that is one of its choices.

ViewNode.description: A node of the layout tree: a container that arranges its children, or a component that shows items.

ContainerType.description: grid lays its children out in columns, split side by side (or one above the other) with a divider, tabs one at a time under their titles, stack one after another.

LayoutDirection.description: The way a split or a stack runs.

ViewContainer.description: A container: it arranges its children and shows no items itself.

children.description: In order. Under tabs, each child's title is its tab.

ComponentType.description: The component catalogue: list, table, card, detail (the selected item, else the binding's first), calendar, agenda, kanban (a column per groupBy value), chart, markdown (text) and stat (how many items, or text for the first).

CalendarRange.description: How much time a calendar or an agenda shows at once.

ChartKind.description: How a chart draws: metric items as their points, other items as counts per groupBy value.

ViewComponent.description: A component: it shows the items its binding matches, each with its fields, and offers its actions on them.

fields.description: What each item shows, in order: a table's columns, a card's lines.

empty.description: Shown when the binding matches nothing.

Template.description: Text in which {path} is a field of the item in scope (or a param: {params.days}), and {path|time}, {path|date}, {path|relative} or {path|number} formats it. {{ and }} are literal braces. There is no expression language in v0.

ViewField.description: One field of an item as a component shows it.

label.description: A table's column header, a card's label.

ViewAction.description: A command the component offers on an item. Every action is a command: keys, the palette, Eris and agents run the same one.

title.description: Shown on the button and in the action menu.

args.description: Passed to the command. Any JSON value; strings in it are templates over the item ({id}).

ViewProvenance.description: Who made the view, when, and from which words. It travels with the view when it is shared.

author.description: person, eris, an agent's name or a plugin id.

words.description: What the person said to have it made.

brain.description: The brain that wrote it, when one did.
